description: Firmographic enrichment for a list of company domains, read from each company's own public homepage: name, description, industry, country, official profiles, language, generator and the third-party hosts it loads. Every value carries the URL and extraction method that produced it. No third-party data provider and no personal data. Choose this to turn a list of company domains into firmographic records where every value names the page and the extraction method it came from. Do not choose this for contact people, email addresses or phone numbers (personal data is refused), or for a domain with no public homepage. Example requests: Enrich these company domains with name, description, country and industry. | Build a firmographic profile for each domain from the company's own website. | Tell me what industry and country these companies are in, with the source.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

domains.description: Company domains, comma or space separated (at most 20).

fields.description: Optional: the subset of fields wanted (name, description, industry, country, same_as, language, generator, third_party_hosts, mx_present). Default: all of them.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_crm_data_enrichment
title: Company Profile Enrichment
